method.warm: All 10,000 maps; 3 repetitions/map; variants and bytes/file/timestamp/slider-length workloads rotate within each map; second run reverses orders. Includes complete result release; default GC.
method.first: 100 evenly selected maps; 3 fresh interpreters per variant/map; two reversed orders. Import, first file parse and release, and whole-process time separately measured.
method.experiments: Screening only: 2,000 evenly selected maps, isolated variant processes, 3 complete passes each, forward and reverse variant orders. Exceptions: extras use 2 passes/order and factory has one order. GC enabled except explicitly named diagnostic.
method.phases: Instrumented baseline on 2,000 maps. Native, conversion and release probes add overhead; GC callback time overlaps other phases and is not additive. Probe tuple construction/wrapper/deferred GC are outside the conversion probe.

validation: All Python-visible values compared with native reference through both bytes and file APIs on all 10,000 maps, on both machines. 34 installed-package tests and CPython debug allocator checks; Python 3.10/3.12/3.14; scalar, NEON and AVX2.
